text:
It passes, goes, is lost,
does not stop,
flows,
springs endlessly,
slips from our hands,
runs, flies toward its end,
glides,
goes dark,
annihilates itself,
fades,
comes undone,
is over.

translation.title: Pasa se va se pierde
